asset.name: Registration confirmed
asset.description: Sent to the attendee when they have a place.
asset.subject: You are registered: {{event_row.title}} on {{event_row.event_date}}
asset.html_body:
See you at {{event_row.title}}

Hi {{form.name}},

Your place is confirmed for {{event_row.title}} on {{event_row.event_date}} at {{event_row.start_time}}, {{event_row.venue}}.

Dietary requirements: {{form.dietary}}.{{=IF(IS_EMPTY(form.special_request), "", " We have passed your request to the organiser, who will reply shortly.")}}

Your reference: {{reg_ref}}. Can't make it? Reply to this email so we can offer the place to someone on the waitlist.

Sent by the event registration workflow
